about.headline: Clément Seguin, independent web designer.
paragraphs: I build websites for freelancers and SMBs. No agency, no intermediary — you work directly with me, from the first call to delivery.
My approach: a free mockup before any commitment, a custom design that reflects your business, and fast delivery so you can start turning visitors into clients.
about.currently: ✦ Available for new projects — reply within 24h.

items.q: Do I pay before seeing the result?
items.a: No. The mockup is free and commitment-free. You only pay after validating it.

items.q: What is included in the 5 days?
items.a: Design + development + go-live + domain configuration + working contact form.

items.q: Do I keep ownership of my website?
items.a: Yes, 100%. Code, hosting, domain — everything belongs to you.

items.q: What if I need changes after delivery?
items.a: Minor edits are included for the first month. After that, monthly maintenance at €40/month or on demand.

items.q: I'm not technical — is that a problem?
items.a: That's exactly who I work for. You don't need to handle anything technical.
